## Project Overview

This repository provides Apache JMeter GUI in Docker containers with browser-based access.

- Two variants: Alpine (minimal) and Ubuntu (full-featured)
- Browser access using noVNC (Alpine) or KasmVNC (Ubuntu)
- Pre-configured JMeter with Plugins Manager
- Multi-platform support via Docker

## Dockerfile Instructions

- Code Style should follow best practices.
  - Use double quotes in shell: `"${VAR}"` not `'${VAR}'` or `$VAR`
  - Indent continuations with 4 spaces
  - One package per line in long package lists
  - Comments explain WHY, not WHAT
  - ENV variables grouped logically at top of Dockerfile
- Maintain Consistency Between Variants
  - Use the same JMeter version
  - Use the same Plugins Manager version
  - Have parallel structure where possible
- Multi-Stage Builds
- Always verify checksums for downloads.

  ```dockerfile
  # ❌ **NEVER do this:**
  RUN wget https://example.com/binary.tar.gz -O /tmp/file.tar.gz \
      && tar -xzf /tmp/file.tar.gz

  # ✅ **ALWAYS do this:**
  ENV BINARY_SHA512="actual_hash_value_here"
  RUN wget https://example.com/binary.tar.gz -O /tmp/file.tar.gz \
      && echo "${BINARY_SHA512}  /tmp/file.tar.gz" | sha512sum -c - \
      && tar -xzf /tmp/file.tar.gz
  ```

  - To calculate SHA512 hashes, use this snippet.

  ```bash
  # For Apache JMeter (official SHA512)
  curl -O https://archive.apache.org/dist/jmeter/binaries/apache-jmeter-X.Y.Z.tgz.sha512

  # For other files (calculate hash)
  curl -o /tmp/file https://example.com/file
  sha512sum /tmp/file
  ```

- When Updating Component Versions.
  1. **Update BOTH Dockerfiles** (Alpine and Ubuntu)
  2. **Obtain new checksums** for all changed components
  3. **Update version in**:
    - Dockerfile ENV variables
    - Dockerfile LABEL version
    - README.md featured tags
    - GitHub Actions workflow tags (if needed)
- Tag Strategy
  - `latest` → Ubuntu variant (most common use case)
  - `X.Y.Z` → Ubuntu variant with semver
  - `X.Y` → Ubuntu variant with major.minor
  - `X.Y.Z-ubuntu24.04` → Explicit Ubuntu variant
  - `X.Y.Z-alpine3.23` → Alpine variant

## Code Review Instructions

When reviewing PRs, verify:

### Security
- [ ] All external downloads have checksum verification
- [ ] Checksums are real (not placeholder values)
- [ ] HTTPS used for all downloads
- [ ] No credentials in code or logs

### Consistency
- [ ] Both Alpine AND Ubuntu Dockerfiles updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Version numbers match across files
- [ ] Documentation updated to match code changes

### Docker Best Practices
- [ ] Multi-stage builds used appropriately
- [ ] Minimal layers created
- [ ] Temporary files cleaned up in same RUN layer
- [ ] No unnecessary packages installed
- [ ] Base images pinned to specific versions

### Testing
- [ ] Local build successful for both variants
- [ ] Container starts and VNC accessible
- [ ] JMeter GUI launches properly
- [ ] Volume mounts work correctly

### Documentation
- [ ] README.md updated if needed
- [ ] Version numbers in README match reality
- [ ] Examples still work with changes
